summary: All hard gates pass. One regression found and fixed: value_probe base0_structure L* p95 failed on Low (RIFT 82, BRIDGE 80.5; bar <= 80) because the max env ENV-2 hour-ward glaze rim (a fixed ~1.5 px dawnglass rim on protected base structures) is a larger share of the tower at 720p. A/B with the ward off read 79 / 76, so the ward alone added +3 / +4.5. Fix in src/render/ink.ts valeGlaze: rim alpha 0.55 -> 0.40 and rim colour gain 0.9+0.5*rim -> 0.85+0.25*rim (the rim, fresnel hairline and shimmer band all stay); re-run reads 79.5 / 76.5 Low and 77.5 / 75 High, 0 FAIL on all six map/tier cells. The fix source landed in wip sync 601960631. The real-time match ran twice and came back not_measured both times because of outside load spikes (5-min load 3.31, then 4.6 from macOS Spotlight indexing, spotlightknowledged at ~100 % CPU); the second run reads 99.8 % of seconds at 58+ with the worst second at 46 frames, which the harness labels 'would pass'.
